exactFinding: /get-matched/ is declared with priority 0.9 and weekly changeFrequency in app/sitemap.ts, but app/get-matched/page.tsx explicitly sets robots: { index: false, follow: false }.
evidenceSource: Google Search Central: Robots meta tag and X-Robots-Tag HTTP header specifications; app/sitemap.ts line 22; app/get-matched/page.tsx line 11
userImpact: Critical indexation conflict. Google Search Console flags 'Submitted URL marked noindex', which degrades site health, confuses search crawlers, and squanders crawl budget.
recommendedAction: Resolve architectural intent: either remove /get-matched/ from app/sitemap.ts, or remove noindex from app/get-matched/page.tsx and provide rich conversion metadata.
evidenceRequired: Google Search Console Coverage report check; sitemap and robots directive parity test.

sourceLocation: Metadata across 25 page routes (app/calculator/page.tsx, app/calculators/page.tsx, etc.)
exactFinding: 25 of 44 public pages specify relative canonical paths (e.g. alternates: { canonical: '/calculator/' }) rather than absolute URLs (https://settlementcheck.co.uk/calculator/), while 2 pages lack canonical tags entirely.
evidenceSource: RFC 5988 / RFC 6596; Google Search Central: Consolidate duplicate URLs with canonical links
userImpact: Relative canonicals create ambiguity when pages are mirrored, scraped, or accessed across subdomains, potentially causing search engines to index non-canonical variants.
recommendedAction: Configure metadataBase: new URL('https://settlementcheck.co.uk') in app/layout.tsx and standardize all page-level alternates.canonical to absolute paths.
evidenceRequired: Automated regex scan verifying 100% of canonical links start with https://settlementcheck.co.uk/.

exactFinding: 16 page titles exceed the 60-character SERP display budget (e.g. /settlement-agreement-review/ is 86 characters: 'Employment Settlement Agreement Checker | Check Your Offer & Clauses | SettlementCheck'), and 7 page titles are under 50 characters.
evidenceSource: Google Search Central: Control your title links in search results; SERP snippet display limit (580px desktop, 920px mobile)
userImpact: Search engine title links are truncated with ellipses on Google SERPs, hiding key value propositions and reducing organic click-through rates.
recommendedAction: Recalibrate all 16 oversized titles to strictly 50–60 characters (including brand suffix ' | SettlementCheck') preserving primary statutory keywords.
evidenceRequired: SEO title length test confirming 100% of public page titles are between 50 and 60 characters.

exactFinding: 20 meta descriptions exceed 155 characters (up to 188 characters on /for-solicitors/), and 8 meta descriptions are under 140 characters, violating the 140–155 character optimal snippet budget.
evidenceSource: Google Search Central: Create good meta descriptions; Moz SERP snippet length guidelines
userImpact: Meta descriptions are cut off in SERP snippets before users can read the active call to action or key statutory reassurance.
recommendedAction: Recalibrate all 20 oversized and 8 undersized descriptions into the 140–155 character range using Answer-First figures and active verbs.
evidenceRequired: Metadata length validation test passing 100% of public descriptions.

sourceLocation: 9 public/utility pages (app/get-matched/, app/results/, app/portal/, app/for-solicitors/, etc.)
exactFinding: 9 pages contain zero Schema.org JSON-LD structured data, and only 9 pages implement BreadcrumbList schema.
evidenceSource: Google Search Central: Structured data general guidelines; Schema.org WebApplication, BreadcrumbList, Organization specifications
userImpact: Missed eligibility for rich search results, site breadcrumbs in SERPs, and enhanced E-E-A-T entity graph association.
recommendedAction: Deploy WebApplication and FAQPage schema to /get-matched/, BreadcrumbList across all guide spokes, and Organization schema to /for-solicitors/.
evidenceRequired: Google Rich Results Test validation passing with zero errors.

sourceLocation: Calculator pages vs Guide articles (e.g. /redundancy-calculator/ vs /guides/redundancy-pay-cap-2026/)
exactFinding: Internal keyword cannibalization between transactional calculator tools and informational guide spokes targeting identical core search queries without clear directional anchor linking.
evidenceSource: Google Search Console Search Performance report; serp-snapshot query distribution analysis
userImpact: Search engine algorithms split ranking signals between informational guides and transactional calculators, preventing either from reaching top 3 SERP positions.
recommendedAction: Implement strict programmatic hub-and-spoke internal linking where guides pass PageRank to calculator tools via exact-match anchor text, and calculators link to guides for statutory explanations.
evidenceRequired: Internal link audit confirming dedicated reciprocal linking between guide-tool pairs.

exactFinding: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) structural deficiency: guide articles lack direct answer sentence structures in the first sentence under H2 headers, reducing extractability for Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Google AI Overviews.
evidenceSource: Anthropic / OpenAI / Google AI Overviews documentation on content extraction and information gain
userImpact: Conversational AI engines cite competitor sites that state statutory figures immediately in sentence 1 rather than SettlementCheck.
recommendedAction: Restructure all guide H2 sections to follow the 3-part AEO formula: [Direct statutory figure in sentence 1] -> [Statutory basis/citation] -> [Comparative markdown table].
evidenceRequired: AEO audit checklist verifying sentence-1 statutory answers across all 24 guides.

exactFinding: app/robots.ts specifies rules for 7 AI user agents but omits newer AI search and crawler tokens (Meta-ExternalAgent, Amazonbot, Bytespider, DuckAssistBot).
evidenceSource: W3C / RFC 9309 Robots Exclusion Protocol; AI bot registry 2026
userImpact: Emerging AI discovery engines may not index content uniformly or respect crawling boundaries consistently.
recommendedAction: Expand AI bot list in app/robots.ts to include all active AI search crawler user agents.
evidenceRequired: Robots.txt validator test confirming multi-agent syntax validity.

exactFinding: Google AI Overviews (AIO) zero-click suppression: informational queries like 'compromise agreement calculator' (476 impr, 0 clicks) and 'employment settlement agreement calculator uk' (377 impr, 0 clicks) lose traffic to Google AI Overview summaries that provide basic definitions without driving click-throughs to our interactive calculator tool.
evidenceSource: Google Search Console live performance data; Google AI Overview SERP features; Pew / SparkToro Zero-Click Search studies
userImpact: Searchers read the static AI Overview answer and bounce without clicking through, suppressing platform user acquisition and solicitor lead generation.
recommendedAction: Implement the 'Interactive Tool Hook' in meta descriptions and H2 intros emphasizing that AI Overviews cannot compute age-bracketed redundancy, PENP notice pay, or tax spillover; add structured comparison tables to secure AIO citation carousel placement.
evidenceRequired: AIO citation audit verifying appearance in Google AI Overview link carousel.
